skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply advanced microeconomic theories and models to analyze economic behavior and policies.
Use quantitative methods to analyze consumer and producer behavior, market structures, and economic policies.
Analyze decision-making under risk and uncertainty, and understand risk attitudes and mitigation strategies.
Apply mathematical tools to economic models and problems.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze complex economic issues and policies.
Conduct independent research and work in groups to solve economic problems and present findings.
Communicate economic concepts and research findings effectively through writing and presentations.
Work collaboratively in teams to solve economic problems and present solutions.
Develop self-learning and research skills to enhance knowledge in advanced microeconomic topics.
